objective.statement: A local-first tool that routes developer queries to the most capable available LLM based on task complexity, minimising latency and cost.
objective.for: Developers running local and cloud LLM backends simultaneously.
objective.problem: Developers must manually decide which LLM to use per task, switching tools and accepting unnecessary latency or cost for simple queries.

functionalRequirements.description: Developer can submit a query and receive a response routed to an appropriate backend.
functionalRequirements.notes: Routing decision is invisible to the developer unless they opt into verbose mode.
functionalRequirements.name: Create Account

functionalRequirements.description: Developer can configure which backends are available and their priority order.
functionalRequirements.name: Login

functionalRequirements.description: Developer can view a log of past queries, which backend handled each, and response latency.
functionalRequirements.name: Logout

functionalRequirements.description: Developer can force a specific backend for a query by passing an explicit override flag.
functionalRequirements.name: Reset Password

functionalRequirements.description: Gateway falls back to the next available backend if the preferred backend is unavailable.
functionalRequirements.name: Update Profile
Profile Management
functionalRequirements.description: The system shall allow users to manage their profile information including password, email, and display preferences.

nonFunctionalRequirements.scale: Routing overhead in milliseconds added to a query round-trip
nonFunctionalRequirements.meter: Measured locally with a no-op backend at 50 sequential queries
nonFunctionalRequirements.name: Performance

nonFunctionalRequirements.scale: Percentage of queries that fail due to gateway error (not backend error)
nonFunctionalRequirements.meter: Error rate measured over 1000 consecutive queries in integration test
nonFunctionalRequirements.name: Reliability

nonFunctionalRequirements.scale: Supported operating systems without code changes
nonFunctionalRequirements.meter: Manual smoke test on each platform after each release
nonFunctionalRequirements.name: Portability

successCriteria.verificationMethod: Integration test with primary backend disabled.

nonGoals.name: Mobile App
nonGoals.description: The system will not support multiple users or account management in this release.
nonGoals.reason: Deferred to a future version; single-developer use only for this release.

nonGoals.name: Third Party Integration
nonGoals.description: No web interface will be provided; configuration is done via CLI and config files.
nonGoals.reason: Out of scope; CLI and config file are sufficient for the target user.

nonGoals.name: Legacy Migration
nonGoals.description: The gateway will not modify or train models; it only routes to existing backends.
nonGoals.reason: Out of scope; gateway routes to existing backends, does not modify them.
